verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. It partitions the binary words of length 2k+1 having at least k+1 ones according to the number j of zeros preceding the (k+1)-st one, correctly counts each part as 2^{k-j} binom{k+j}{j}, and then uses bitwise complementation to show that exactly half of all binary words lie in this set, giving cardinality 4^k. All steps are justified, and there are no external references or hard-prohibition violations.
